title: androrchis × kretzschmariorum
intro: Androrchis × kretzschmariorum, commonly known as the Kretzschmar's orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that is a cross between Androrchis aetibasis and Anthericum liliago. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Androrchis × kretzschmariorum include soothing and calming the nervous system, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. Its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its mechanisms and effects.
